fact: The National Identification Authority's fee schedule lists first-time registration, renewal, replacement and record update of the national ID card for refugees, at the cedi equivalent of USD15 per person (records update only is free).
The National Identification Authority plans a continuous registration exercise that includes 10,000 refugees and asylum-seekers for the Ghana Card.
